title: Molecular Gas Filaments and Star-forming Knots Beneath an X-Ray Cavity in RXC J1504-0248
question: What are the mass, morphology, kinematics, origin and star formation of the molecular gas in the RXCJ1504 BCG, and how does it relate to an X-ray cavity?

data.sensitivity: RMS 0.2 mJy/beam (CO 1-0, 20 km/s) and 0.65 mJy/beam (CO 3-2, 10 km/s)

what.value: Global extinction-corrected SFR of 136 Msun/yr (GALEX NUV)

evidence.quote: was measured using NUV GALEX observations (rest-frame FUV) to be $136\hbox{$\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}\rm\; yr^{-1}\,$}$ (cite: Ogrean10).
recovered an integrated CO(1-0) flux of $3.84\pm0.62\hbox{$\rm\; Jy\rm\; km\rm\; s^{-1}\,$}$ (Edge, unpublished).

what.value: Redshift z=0.216902 from optical emission lines
Radio SED points (GMRT 327 MHz, VLA 1.4 GHz AGN components, VLBI)

evidence.quote: (cite: Giacintucci11) isolated the contribution from the AGN by modelling the spatial distribution with a two dimensional Gaussian.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image CO cubes and continuum
recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, uvcontsub, clean with Briggs weighting, uv taper for CO(3-2), phase self-calibration of continuum
Power law S ∝ nu^-alpha to ALMA plus literature radio points

recipe.goal: Extract and fit integrated and regional spectra
recipe.method: One or two Gaussian components fitted with LMFIT; Monte Carlo test with at least 1000 iterations and 3 sigma detection; numerical integration also done
M_mol = 1.05e4 (X_CO/X_CO,gal) S Dv D_L^2/(1+z); CO(3-2) converted with ratio 9

recipe.goal: Map flux, velocity, FWHM and extract position-velocity curve
recipe.method: Per-pixel Gaussian fitting; PV from CO(3-2) along filament path in 0.6 arcsec intervals with 0.75 arcsec width
Fit PV curve with Hernquist-potential free-fall model v_obs = v sin i + v_ICM; v_ICM and i free, r0 fixed at 17.5 kpc
key_parameters: Hernquist a = 5.2 kpc; stellar mass 5e11 Msun
assumptions: Cloud starts at rest with respect to ICM; Hernquist potential

recipe.goal: Compute local SFRs from HST FUV and fit star formation law
recipe.method: FUV count rates in regions scaled to global SFR; fit Sigma_SFR = A (Sigma_H2/100)^N in log space
assumptions: SFR uncertainty factor of two; Salim07 UV calibration (Chabrier IMF)

evidence.quote: the total molecular gas mass measured with the higher-fidelity CO(3-2) spectrum is $1.9\pm0.1\ensuremath{\times 10^{10}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$.
The spectral index of the power law is $\alpha=0.41\pm0.03$.
a flux density of $8.734\pm0.015\rm\; mJy$ at $101.7945\rm\; GHz$
The total molecular gas mass in the filament is $4.8\ensuremath{\times 10^{9}}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$
the velocity gradient is $16\hbox{$\rm\; km\rm\; s^{-1}\,$}\rm\; kpc^{-1}$
we estimate a mass flow rate of $75\hbox{$\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}\rm\; yr^{-1}\,$}$.

answer_key.quantity: Free-fall inclination to plane of sky (r0=17.5 kpc)

evidence.quote: requires an inclination angle of $-22^{\circ}$ with a bulk offset of $v_{\rm ICM}=140\hbox{$\rm\; km\rm\; s^{-1}\,$}$

answer_key.quantity: Star formation law fit, all gas: A and N

evidence.quote: Fitting this SF law to the entire gas distribution yields $A=0.58\pm0.11$ and $N=0.64\pm0.18$.

answer_key.quantity: Star formation law fit, central gas: A and N

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum-subtraction order for uvcontsub
Clean masks, threshold, niter, cell and image size
Exact HST data sets and pipeline products, and manual shifts beyond those quoted
Regions (polygon and extraction boxes) definitions for spectra and SFR
Flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
Extraction details of the Chandra surface brightness profile and cavity region
Background region for FUV count rates
missing_for_reproduction: Region definitions for spectra and SFRs
HST data identifiers and alignment details
score_reason: ALMA data are public and main steps are described with many numeric results, but imaging parameters, regions and several inputs (HST alignment, unpublished IRAM flux) are not fully given.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric masses, line ratios and fits that can be re-derived, though some settings are missing.
